parameters.query:
SELECT
    c.id AS clause_id,
    c.document_id,
    c.clause_type,
    c.clause_text,
    c.page_no,
    c.confidence,
    c.risk_score,
    c.risk_level,
    c.is_absent,
    c.review_status,
    COALESCE(c.extracted_fields->>'attribution', 'unknown') AS attribution,
    d.filename,
    (
        COALESCE(c.extracted_fields->>'attribution', '') = 'not_found'
        OR (c.is_absent AND COALESCE(c.risk_score, 0) >= 0.60)
    ) AS needs_review,
    (
        SELECT COUNT(*)
        FROM review_requests rr
        WHERE rr.clause_id = c.id
          AND rr.status = 'pending'
    ) AS pending_requests
FROM clauses c
JOIN documents d ON d.id = c.document_id
WHERE c.id = $1;

INSERT INTO review_requests
    (clause_id, document_id, reason, reviewer, status, sent_at)
VALUES
    ($1, $2, $3, $4, 'pending', NOW())
RETURNING id AS review_request_id, token, clause_id, document_id;

parameters.formDescription: Review the extracted clause below and record and decision.

parameters.query:
INSERT INTO email_outbox
    (purpose, review_request_id, document_id, to_address, subject, body_text, status)
VALUES
    ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6, 'queued')
RETURNING id AS email_id, to_address, subject;

UPDATE clauses
SET review_status = 'approved'
WHERE id = $1
RETURNING id AS clause_id, review_status;

UPDATE clauses
SET review_status = 'corrected',
    clause_text = $2
WHERE id = $1
RETURNING id AS clause_id, review_status, clause_text;

UPDATE clauses
SET review_status = 'rejected'
WHERE id = $1
RETURNING id AS clause_id, review_status;

UPDATE review_requests
SET status = 'decided',
    decision = $2,
    corrected_text = $3,
    reviewer_note = $4,
    decided_at = NOW()
WHERE id = $1 AND status = 'pending'
RETURNING id AS review_request_id, decision, status, decided_at;

INSERT INTO gold_labels
    (contract_title, pdf_filename, split, clause_type,
     expected_text, answer_start, is_absent, source)
VALUES
    ($1, $2, 'dev', $3, $4, -1, FALSE, 'lawyer_review')
ON CONFLICT (pdf_filename, clause_type, answer_start) DO NOTHING
RETURNING id AS gold_label_id, clause_type, source;
